title: nutty cozy algerian cheese-pull tagine
description: a comforting, cheesy, and nutty take on traditional algerian cuisine, featuring the subtle sweetness of fennel and the richness of cheese

ingredients.name: temper chocolate
ingredients.notes: use dairy-free chocolate for vegan version

ingredients.name: algerian spice mix
ingredients.notes: or create your own blend with cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and ginger

instructions: heat the temper chocolate in a saucepan over low heat.
add the almond milk and stir until the mixture is smooth.
add the fennel bulb and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
add the hazelnuts, buckwheat groats, algerian spice mix, nutritional yeast, and lemon juice, and stir well.
transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional hazelnuts and fennel bulb, if desired.
cover with foil and bake at 375f for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
serve warm, garnished with additional fennel bulb and hazelnuts, if desired.
